The position requires supplying and placing recycled aggregate for a new unbound road base layer.

items.material_name: 0/32 recycled aggregate road base, Bk1.0, DPr ≥ 1, EV2 ≥ 150 MPa, U ≥ 13, >12–15 cm thick
items.description: TL Gestein recycled aggregate for an unbound road base placed between edge restraints.

decisions.reason: The position requires recycled aggregate for a new frost protection layer.

items.material_name: 0/45 recycled aggregate frost protection layer, Bk1.0, DPr ≥ 1.03, EV2 ≥ 120 MPa, UF 3, >20–30 cm thick
items.description: TL Gestein recycled aggregate with no more than 3% fines after placement.

decisions.reason: The kerbs are reused from site stock, but the position requires new concrete bedding and backing.

items.material_name: C25/30 (LP) XF2 normal-weight concrete kerb bedding, 20 cm thick
items.description: Concrete bedding for reused grey TB 10/25 kerbs, specified to DIN EN 206 and DIN 1045-2.

items.material_name: C20/25 concrete kerb backing, 10 cm thick, one-sided
items.description: Continuous vertical concrete backing for reused grey TB 10/25 kerbs.

decisions.reason: The position requires asphalt mix for a new base course.

items.material_name: AC 22 T N asphalt base course, Bk1.0, 50/70 bitumen, 10 cm thick
items.description: Hand-laid asphalt base mix placed between cut edges, with up to 20% reclaimed asphalt permitted.

decisions.reason: The position requires asphalt concrete for a new wearing course and states the mix mass per square metre.

items.material_name: AC 8 D N asphalt concrete wearing course, Bk1.0, 0/11 mm, 50/70 bitumen, 4 cm thick
items.description: Single-layer, hand-laid wearing mix with SZ 8/12 below 18; reclaimed asphalt is prohibited.

decisions.reason: The position requires new bituminous sealing tape to form the asphalt joint.

items.material_name: Heat-fusible bituminous asphalt joint sealing tape, 40 mm high × 10 mm wide
items.description: Heat-applied sealing tape for a full-depth joint in the asphalt wearing course.
